# Prototype Activity: Incremental Validation (Superseded)

**Workflow status**: This list was generated and executed before planning was
requested. It is retained as a historical prototype record, not an active task
plan. Checked entries record earlier activity only; they do not establish that
the current [015 specification](spec.md) is approved or complete. Scope-dependent
entries are unchecked. Regenerate tasks from the current plan in the tasks phase.

Earlier design: [prototype archive](prototype/design-before-plan.json).
The current [plan.md](plan.md) is not represented by this historical activity list.
Tests are mandatory. Record red/green evidence in evidence.md. No implementation
may mark the review/specification checklist; only these tasks track execution.

## Setup and foundation

- [X] T001 Isolate 015 and preserve original 014 files; record baseline in evidence.md.
- [ ] T002 Resolve scope and design in spec.md, plan.md, research.md, data-model.md and contracts/delta.md.
- [X] T003 [US2] Write failing result/composition and all-operator differential tests in crates/behavior-core/src/delta/tests.rs.
- [X] T004 [US2] Implement the uniform result derivative in crates/behavior-core/src/delta.rs and export workspace module in crates/behavior-core/src/lib.rs.

## US1 and US2: Exact validation and composition

- [X] T005 [US1] Write failing witness/lowering and changed-row/reference tests in crates/behavior-core/src/validation/tests.rs.
- [X] T006 [US1] Factor ordinary row diagnostics in crates/behavior-core/src/eval.rs and implement validation derivative in crates/behavior-core/src/validation.rs.
- [X] T007 [US2] Complete operator inventory and equivalence arguments in construct-mapping.md and correctness.md; test inventory exhaustiveness.

## US3: Committed materialization

- [X] T008 [US3] Write failing create/read, remove/reference, nonlocal reference and failed-CAS tests in crates/behavior-store/tests/incremental_validation.rs.
- [X] T009 [US3] Integrate candidate overlay, reference index patch and Applied-only carry-forward in crates/behavior-store/src/store.rs.
- [X] T010 [US3] Verify generated lifecycle/history/rebuild/error sequences and supported facade usage in crates/behavior-store/tests/incremental_validation.rs and consumer/tests/incremental_validation.rs.

## US4: Workload evidence and final gates

- [X] T011 [US4] Add repeated warm/update-read/create-read measurements in crates/behavior-store/tests/incremental_validation.rs.
- [X] T012 [US4] Measure controlled and private tcup-model workloads and record raw samples, provenance and limitations in evidence.md.
- [ ] T013 Update PRINCIPLES.md and docs/persistence.md with canonical delta-contract links and future operator requirements.
- [X] T014 Run quickstart.md checks and canonical nix develop -c scripts/gates.sh, record exact results in evidence.md and verify original 014 preservation.

Dependencies: T001–T002 before red tests; T003 before T004; T005 before T006;
T004/T006 before T007; T008 before T009; T009 before T010/T011; all before T014.
The inventory can be refined independently of runtime editing. Execute sequentially.
